messages:
maya: first call works locally but our CI job using a service account key returns 402 'billing_required' — anyone seen this?

sam: are you using an org-scoped SA or a workspace-scoped one? 402 usually means billing isn't enabled on the workspace.

maya: workspace-scoped. created via console, injected as REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT in GH secrets. locally i curl with my user API key and it works.

maya: curl output in CI (trimmed):
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"Workspace requires billing setup\"}
```

lee: which endpoint? chat/generate/embeddings? node vs python client?

maya: /v1/chat/completions (hosted). node sdk in CI just hangs ~5m then job fails. python client surfaces 402 immediately. looks like a retry loop in node.

sam: this sounds like an SDK parity/auth-retry issue — node client was updated to auto-refresh tokens and retries auth errors. if 402 is treated as retriable it can cause long hangs.

maya: relevant CI log snippet: "request failed: billing_required" then "refreshing token" repeated 20+ times...

devex-bot: :warning: quick suggestions — 1) attach billing to the workspace; 2) use a user-scoped API key tied to a paid org in CI; 3) as a temp workaround set NODE_SDK_RETRY=0. docs: https://redwood.example/docs/billing-quickstart

ronan: i'm on it. reproducing locally with a workspace SA. looks like node-sdk classifies 402 as transient. i'll open a PR to treat 4xx (billing/perm) as terminal and bubble error to callers.

ronan: short-term workaround — in your GH Actions workflow set REDWOOD_API_KEY to a user key or add env NODE_SDK_RETRY=0. Example (workflow):
```yaml
env:
  NODE_SDK_RETRY: \"0\"
  REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
```

maya: set NODE_SDK_RETRY=0 and reran — CI finished and the job reported 402 immediately instead of hanging. thanks.

lee: we'll cut node-sdk v0.8.2 with the retry fix and a clearer billing_required message (will include workspace id and quick link). also adding a note in quickstart about which key to use in CI.

maya: great, marking this as resolved for my pipeline. :thumbsup: 

sam: filing a small devex doc to clarify recommended auth patterns for CI vs local dev so others don't hit the same confusion.

maya: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage.
